system.description:
Usage placed. Activate Interact (2 AP).

The blue wax burns without shortening until the magic is exhausted.

The candle burns for 8 hours, providing dim light within 10 feet. A willing creature that spends at least 1 hour resting within its light gains a +2-status bonus to saving throws against Fear, possession and harmful dream effects until it completes its next Full Rest.

A creature may benefit from only one Candle of the Quiet Vigil between Full Rests.

On the sheet: used by the creature that rested an hour in its light: the +2 status rides their saves (pre-ticked against Fear, possession and dream effects) until their next Full Rest — the effect is written for 24 hours; end it at the Full Rest.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.

grants.scope: Saving throws against Fear, possession and harmful dream effects (after an hour's rest in its light, until your next Full Rest)
